text:
maria: Quick sync — Orchestrator SDK + Langchain/LlamaIndex adapters + gateway connector + marketplace assets. Goal: dev preview April 10. Who can pick up which parts? :wave:

alex: I can own the LangChain adapter. Need spec for callbacks / function-calling and a small test corpus. Any constraints on streaming vs chunked responses?

kevin: I’ll do gateway connector + deployment docs. Also need an example routing policy and a sample helm/terraform snippet for Dedicated.

sara: DevEx will own SDK quickstarts, samples, and a notebook. Can we re-use the existing /quickstart? If so i'll fork and add an integrations section. Link: https://github.com/redwood/quickstarts

tim: Product: coordinate announcement cadence with LangChain / LlamaIndex PMs. Marketing wants a gated partner announcement 1 week before GA. Are we okay with soft launch on Apr 17?

maria: @tim sounds good. Marketing to confirm. For legal/partner terms — @kevin can you PM legal about the co-marketing blurb?

alex: technical Q: should adapter prefer cached prefixes and fallback to full model? Propose config:
```yaml
adapter:
  prefer_cached_prefix: true
  fallback_model: "redwood/open-variant-v1"
  function_calling: "auto"
  stream_mode: "chunked"
```

kevin: that looks fine. For Dedicated we should expose `routing.priority` so customers can pin low-cost model for batch jobs. Example snippet I’ll add to docs.

sara: i'll add examples showing both streaming and chunked usage with LangChain chains. Also a notebook showing LlamaIndex index+query flow through the gateway.

maria: action items:
- alex -> LangChain adapter PR + test corpus by Apr 3
- kevin -> gateway connector + deploy docs by Apr 6
- sara -> SDK quickstart + notebooks by Apr 8
- tim/marketing -> confirm partner announcement timeline by Apr 9

ci-bot: Created issue #412 in integrations/adapter-track for LangChain adapter (https://github.com/redwood/integrations/issues/412)

alex: ack, starting work today. Will drop a WIP PR and ping reviewers. :thumbsup:

kevin: i'll reach out to legal and infra for marketplace package requirements.

sara: LGTM — will start the notebook template tonight.

maria: great — weekly check-in Thursday 10am PT. If blockers pop up ping this thread. :rocket:
